   211	noncomputable def baseChange.idIso (k : Type u) [Field k] :
   212	    baseChange k k ≅ 𝟭 (Over (Spec (.of k))) :=
   213	  eqToIso (by
   214	    change Over.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k))) = Over.pullback (𝟙 _)
   215	    rw [Algebra.algebraMap_self, CommRingCat.ofHom_id, Spec.map_id]) ≪≫ Over.pullbackId

   233	noncomputable def congr {k : Type u} [Field k] {C C' : Over (Spec (.of k))}
   234	    [IsProper C.hom] [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]

   239	    { hom := e.hom, inv := e.inv, hom_inv_id := e.hom_inv_id, inv_hom_id := e.inv_hom_id }

name: hgraph
description: The dependency graph — Horizon's vendored hgraph core keeps one file per statement/Lean declaration under <project>/hgraph/; `horizon graph frontier` ranks work and agents attach node-scoped comments and reviews. This is the only DAG engine.
---

Each project may carry an **hgraph**: a plain-files semantic graph under
`<project>/hgraph/` — one Markdown node per blueprint statement and per Lean
declaration, typed edges (`uses` = the hard dependency DAG, `formalizes` =
informal↔formal identity). `horizon graph sync` (run automatically at run boundaries)
reconciles the blueprint + Lean sources into it; your **authored** additions
(comments, reviews, metadata) are never touched by sync. The files are
committed to the workspace ledger like everything else.

Use `"$HORIZON_BIN" graph -p <project> …`; when a workspace has one project,
`-p` is optional. Address nodes by `label:<latex-label>` or
`decl:<lean-fqname>` — raw ids are opaque hashes. Most commands accept `--json`.

## Sync it yourself — and act on the warnings

Don't wait for the run boundary: after you change blueprint statements,
`\uses{}`/`\lean{}` annotations, or Lean declarations, run
`"$HORIZON_BIN" graph -p <project> sync` and **read its output**. Sync prints warnings for exactly the defects
you can fix on the spot: `\uses{X} has no blueprint node` (missing/mistyped
label), `\lean{Name} not found in Lean sources` (renamed or unwritten
declaration), stale nodes whose source vanished. Fix what your change caused
before moving on; a warning you deliberately leave (e.g. a forward reference
you'll write next) gets a node comment or a memory item so the next session
knows it's intentional. Sync is idempotent and never touches your authored
comments/reviews/metadata.

## Read

- `"$HORIZON_BIN" graph -p <project> list --state ready` — nodes whose dependencies are all closed:
  provable *now*. Other states: `closed`, `blocked`, `formalized_open`.
- `"$HORIZON_BIN" graph -p <project> frontier` — the ready nodes ranked by how many downstream nodes a
  proof would unlock. **Use this when picking the next node to prove.**
- `"$HORIZON_BIN" graph -p <project> get label:thm:foo` — one node: statement, `lean_status`
  (`lean_ok | mathlib_ok | sorry | empty`, derived from scanning the Lean, not
  from `\leanok`), deps, attached comments/reviews.
- `"$HORIZON_BIN" graph -p <project> ancestors label:thm:foo` — the dependency cone.
- `"$HORIZON_BIN" graph -p <project> stats` — per-state counts for the project.

## Write — per-node progress lives WITH the node

- **Comment = failure memory / progress note on that node.** When an approach
  fails or you learn something node-specific, record it where the next session
  will look first:
  `"$HORIZON_BIN" graph -p <project> add comment label:thm:foo --content "tried simp+ring, fails because …"`
  Agent authorship plus run/session/task provenance are filled from the run
  environment; do not copy the note into the blueprint.
- **Review = a Maths / Lean verdict** (independent axes, `good|bad`):
  `"$HORIZON_BIN" graph -p <project> add review label:thm:foo --maths good --lean bad --lean-comment "statement ok; proof has a sorry at the succ case"`
- **Metadata**: `"$HORIZON_BIN" graph -p <project> modify node label:thm:foo --set status=verified`

Prefer node comments over inbox items for anything scoped to ONE node; use the
inbox (skill: `horizon-inbox`) for cross-node or cross-session coordination.

An edge `source --uses--> target` means *source depends on target*. A node is
"ready" when all of its dependencies are closed; prefer `frontier`, which ranks
ready nodes by what they unlock. The dashboard provides the workspace project
switcher and the chapter-collapsed Graphviz view.

## Relation to the blueprint

The DAG **is** the hgraph — there is no second engine and no parser fallback.
It is generated by resolving the blueprint's `\uses{}`/`\lean{}` annotations
against the real Lean sources, so keeping those annotations correct (skill:
`blueprint-conventions`) is exactly what keeps this graph correct. Unresolved
references surface as `horizon graph sync` warnings and as `dangling` entries — read
the warnings rather than trusting `dangling` alone.

     9	/-!
    10	# The quotient-side bridge for finite Galois descent of Picard zero
    11	
    12	A specified finite Galois quotient represents equivariant maps after base
    13	change.  This file records that statement in the over-category.  It is the
    14	scheme-theoretic half of descending a representative of `pic0TypeFunctor`.
    15	-/
    16	
    17	set_option autoImplicit false
    18	
    19	universe u
    20	
    21	open CategoryTheory Limits
    22	open AlgebraicGeometry
    23	
    24	namespace AlgebraicJacobian.GaloisDescent
    25	
    26	/-- An equivariant map from the finite-Galois base change of an object over
    27	`Spec K` to a semilinearly acted `L`-scheme. -/
    28	structure GaloisEquivariantOver
    29	    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    30	    {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
    31	    (rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f)
    32	    (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))) where
    33	  hom : pullback T.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))) ⟶ X
    34	  commutes : hom ≫ f =
    35	    pullback.snd T.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))
    36	  equivariant : (pullbackSemilinearGalAction K L T.hom).IsEquivariant rho hom
    37	
    38	namespace GaloisEquivariantOver
    39	
    40	variable {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    41	  {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
    42	  (rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f)
    43	
    44	/-- Pull an equivariant map back along a morphism over `Spec K`. -/
    45	noncomputable def precomp
    46	    {T T' : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))} (a : T' ⟶ T)
    47	    (h : GaloisEquivariantOver rho T) : GaloisEquivariantOver rho T' where
    48	  hom := pullbackBaseChange K L T.hom T'.hom a.left a.w ≫ h.hom
    49	  commutes := by
    50	    rw [Category.assoc, h.commutes, pullbackBaseChange_snd]
    51	  equivariant := SemilinearGalAction.isEquivariant_pullbackBaseChange_comp
    52	    T.hom T'.hom rho h.equivariant a.left a.w
    53	
    54	@[ext]
    55	theorem ext {T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))}
    56	    {h h' : GaloisEquivariantOver rho T} (hh : h.hom = h'.hom) : h = h' := by
    57	  cases h
    58	  cases h'
    59	  cases hh
    60	  rfl
    61	
    62	end GaloisEquivariantOver
    63	
    64	namespace GaloisQuotientWitness
    65	
    66	variable {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    67	  {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
    68	  {rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f}
    69	  {Y : Scheme.{u}} {g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
    70	
    71	/-- A finite-Galois quotient witness represents equivariant maps after base
    72	change, with no affineness assumption on the test object. -/
    73	noncomputable def overHomEquiv (w : GaloisQuotientWitness rho Y g)
    74	    (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))) :
    75	    (T ⟶ Over.mk g) ≃ GaloisEquivariantOver rho T where
    76	  toFun a :=
    77	    { hom := pullbackBaseChange K L g T.hom a.left a.w ≫ w.e.hom
    78	      commutes := by
    79	        rw [Category.assoc, w.over, pullbackBaseChange_snd]
    80	      equivariant := SemilinearGalAction.isEquivariant_pullbackBaseChange_comp
    81	        g T.hom rho w.equivariant a.left a.w }
    82	  invFun h :=
    83	    Over.homMk
    84	      (w.universal T.left T.hom h.hom h.commutes h.equivariant).choose.1
    85	      (w.universal T.left T.hom h.hom h.commutes h.equivariant).choose.2
    86	  left_inv a := by
    87	    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    88	    let h := pullbackBaseChange K L g T.hom a.left a.w ≫ w.e.hom
    89	    let hw := w.universal T.left T.hom h
    90	      (by
    91	        dsimp [h]
    92	        rw [Category.assoc, w.over, pullbackBaseChange_snd])
    93	      (by
    94	        dsimp [h]
    95	        exact SemilinearGalAction.isEquivariant_pullbackBaseChange_comp
    96	          g T.hom rho w.equivariant a.left a.w)
    97	    have ha : pullbackBaseChange K L g T.hom a.left a.w ≫ w.e.hom = h := rfl
    98	    have heq : hw.choose = ⟨a.left, a.w⟩ :=
    99	      hw.unique hw.choose_spec.1 ha
   100	    exact congrArg Subtype.val heq
   101	  right_inv h := by
   102	    apply GaloisEquivariantOver.ext rho
   103	    exact (w.universal T.left T.hom h.hom h.commutes h.equivariant).choose_spec.1
   104	
   105	/-- The quotient universal-property equivalence commutes with precomposition
   106	in the category of schemes over `Spec K`. -/
   107	theorem overHomEquiv_precomp (w : GaloisQuotientWitness rho Y g)
   108	    {T T' : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))} (a : T' ⟶ T)
   109	    (b : T ⟶ Over.mk g) :
   110	    w.overHomEquiv T' (a ≫ b) =
   111	      GaloisEquivariantOver.precomp rho a (w.overHomEquiv T b) := by
   112	  apply GaloisEquivariantOver.ext rho
   113	  change pullbackBaseChange K L g T'.hom (a.left ≫ b.left) _ ≫ w.e.hom =
   114	    pullbackBaseChange K L T.hom T'.hom a.left a.w ≫
   115	      (pullbackBaseChange K L g T.hom b.left b.w ≫ w.e.hom)
   116	  rw [pullbackBaseChange_comp K L g T.hom T'.hom b.left b.w a.left a.w,
   117	    Category.assoc]
   118	
   119	end GaloisQuotientWitness
   120	
   121	namespace StableAffineOpen
   122	
   123	variable {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
   124	  {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
   125	  (rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f)
   126	
   127	/-- Under the orbit-in-an-affine-open hypothesis, the glued invariant-ring
   128	quotient represents equivariant maps after finite Galois base change. -/
   129	noncomputable def gluedQuotientOverHomEquiv
   130	    [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L] [rho.OrbitsInAffineOpen]
   131	    (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))) :
   132	    (T ⟶ gluedQuotientOver rho) ≃ GaloisEquivariantOver rho T :=
   133	  (gluedGaloisQuotientWitness rho).toGaloisQuotientWitness.overHomEquiv T
   134	
   135	/-- The glued-quotient equivalence is natural under precomposition. -/
   136	theorem gluedQuotientOverHomEquiv_precomp
   137	    [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L] [rho.OrbitsInAffineOpen]
   138	    {T T' : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))} (a : T' ⟶ T)
   139	    (b : T ⟶ gluedQuotientOver rho) :
   140	    gluedQuotientOverHomEquiv rho T' (a ≫ b) =
   141	      GaloisEquivariantOver.precomp rho a (gluedQuotientOverHomEquiv rho T b) :=
   142	  GaloisQuotientWitness.overHomEquiv_precomp
   143	    (gluedGaloisQuotientWitness rho).toGaloisQuotientWitness a b
   144	
   145	end StableAffineOpen
   146	
   147	end AlgebraicJacobian.GaloisDescent

import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivRepAffChallenge
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0AtlasFromDivRep

/-!
# Category-correct ambient contract for the rank-one Picard route

The rank-one locus lives in degree `genus C`, not in `pic0`. This module installs the concrete
ambient maps that the later open-locus restriction must consume:

* `abelDivAffTrans` maps the widened degree-`n` divisor functor to `picDegLayerFunctor C n`;
* `abelDivAffSigma` extends a represented slice map to the ambient big-site presheaf;
* `abelDivAffGenusSigma` specializes the map using the canonical genus representation.

The future public `PicRankOneOpen` must therefore be a subfunctor of
`picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C)`, and `DivRankOneOpen` must be an open of
`divRepAffGenusScheme C`. Its `rankOneAbel` is the restriction of
`abelDivAffGenusSigma`, after applying the corresponding Sigma extension. No placeholder locus,
inverse, representability witness, or endgame theorem is postulated here.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))} {n : ℕ}
variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
variable [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]

noncomputable section

variable (C n) in
/-- The widened Abel transformation into the intrinsic degree-`n` Picard layer. -/
def abelDivAffTrans : divFunctorAff C n ⟶ picDegLayerFunctor C (n : ℤ) where
  app T := ↾fun s => ⟨abelDivAff' C n T.unop s, fun K _ _ t => degAt_abelDivAff' s t⟩
  naturality T T' g := by
    ext s
    refine Subtype.ext ?_
    exact (picEtMap_abelDivAff' g.unop s).symm

@[simp]
lemma abelDivAffTrans_app_coe
    (T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ) (s : divFamZarAff C n T.unop) :
    ((abelDivAffTrans C n).app T s).1 = abelDivAff' C n T.unop s :=
  rfl

variable (C n) in
/-- Extend a represented widened Abel map from the slice over `Spec k` to the big site. -/
def abelDivAffSigma {D : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    (rep : (divFunctorAff C n).RepresentableBy D) :
    yoneda.obj D.left ⟶
      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (n : ℤ)) :=
  rep.toSigmaExtension ≫ Over.sigmaExtensionNat (abelDivAffTrans C n)

@[simp]
lemma abelDivAffSigma_app_fst {D : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    (rep : (divFunctorAff C n).RepresentableBy D) (T : Schemeᵒᵖ)
    (x : T.unop ⟶ D.left) :
    ((abelDivAffSigma C n rep).app T x).1 = x ≫ D.hom :=
  rfl

@[simp]
lemma abelDivAffSigma_app_coe {D : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    (rep : (divFunctorAff C n).RepresentableBy D) (T : Schemeᵒᵖ)
    (x : T.unop ⟶ D.left) :
    ((abelDivAffSigma C n rep).app T x).2.1 =
      abelDivAff' C n (Over.mk (x ≫ D.hom)) (rep.homEquiv (Over.homMk x rfl)) :=
  rfl

variable (C) in
/-- The ambient genus-degree Abel map on the canonical represented widened divisor scheme.

This is the map that the future rank-one divisor open must restrict. It is not itself claimed to
be an open immersion. -/
def abelDivAffGenusSigma :
    yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C).left ⟶
      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) :=
  abelDivAffSigma C (genus C) (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C)

end

end AlgebraicGeometry

3. "Find lemma with type pattern" -> lean_loogle
4. "What's the Lean name for concept X?" -> lean_leanfinder

   179	  NatIso.ofComponents (fun T => (pic0GenusTranslationEquiv (C := C) a T.unop).toIso) (by
   180	    intro T T' f
   181	    ext lam
   182	    refine Subtype.ext ?_
   183	    have key :
   184	        picEtMap C f.unop ((pic0Subgroup C T.unop).subtype lam) *
   185	            thetaFamily C a.1 T'.unop =
   186	          picEtMap C f.unop
   187	            ((pic0Subgroup C T.unop).subtype lam * thetaFamily C a.1 T.unop) := by
   188	      rw [map_mul, thetaFamily_natural]
   189	    exact key)
   190	
   191	/-! ## The translated rank-one charts -/
   192	
   193	/-- The certified divisor open, transported by the canonical Abel isomorphism, represents the
   194	rank-one Picard locus on the big site. -/
   195	noncomputable def picRankOneOpenSigmaIso
   196	    (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) (divRepAffP1Map C)) :
   197	    yoneda.obj (divRankOneOpenOver (divRepAffP1Map C) h).left ≅
   198	      rankOneLocus (C := C) (pi := divRepAffP1Map C) :=
   199	  representableBySigmaIso
   200	      (rankOneDivisorOpenRepresentableBy (C := C) (divRepAffP1Map C) h) ≪≫
   201	    canonicalRankOneAbelIso (C := C)
   202	
   203	/-- The chart indexed by a base class `a` of degree `genus C`: first use canonical Abel on the
   204	rank-one divisor open, then multiply by `a⁻¹` to return to degree zero. -/
   205	noncomputable def picRankOneTranslatedChart
   206	    (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) (divRepAffP1Map C))
   207	    (a : PicRankOneTranslatorIndex (C := C)) :
   208	    yoneda.obj (divRankOneOpenOver (divRepAffP1Map C) h).left ⟶
   209	      (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1 :=
   210	  (picRankOneOpenSigmaIso (C := C) h).hom ≫
   211	    picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl (divRepAffP1Map C) ≫
   212	      (sigmaExtensionIso (pic0GenusTranslationIso (C := C) a)).inv
   213	
   214	/-- Every translated rank-one chart is a representable open immersion. -/
   215	theorem picRankOneTranslatedChart_isOpenImmersion
   216	    (hopen : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen (divRepAffP1Map C))
   217	    (a : PicRankOneTranslatorIndex (C := C)) :
   218	    IsOpenImmersion.presheaf
   219	      (picRankOneTranslatedChart (C := C)
   220	        (divRankOneOpenDataOfPicRankOneOpen (divRepAffP1Map C) hopen) a) := by
   221	  apply MorphismProperty.IsStableUnderComposition.comp_mem
   222	  · apply MorphismProperty.IsStableUnderComposition.comp_mem
   223	    · exact MorphismProperty.of_isIso (P := IsOpenImmersion.presheaf) _
   224	    · exact MorphismProperty.of_isIso (P := IsOpenImmersion.presheaf) _
   225	  · apply MorphismProperty.IsStableUnderComposition.comp_mem
   226	    · exact hopen
   227	    · exact MorphismProperty.of_isIso (P := IsOpenImmersion.presheaf) _
   228	
   229	/-! ## Finiteness of the translated charts -/
   230	
   231	/-- The chosen genus divisor representer is locally of finite type over the base.  In positive
   232	genus it is definitionally a divisor scheme.  In genus zero, representer uniqueness transports
   233	the certificate from the terminal representer. -/
   234	theorem locallyOfFiniteType_divRepAffGenusScheme :
   235	    LocallyOfFiniteType (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom := by
   236	  by_cases hg : genus C = 0
   237	  · let D0 : Over (Spec (.of k)) := Over.mk (𝟙 (Spec (.of k)))
   238	    have rep0 : (divFunctorAff C (genus C)).RepresentableBy D0 := by
   239	      rw [hg]
   240	      exact divFunctorAffZeroRepresentableBy (C := C) (pi := divRepAffP1Map C)

===== seprep2 =====
   241	    let e := (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).uniqueUpToIso rep0
   242	    haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType D0.hom := by
   243	      change LocallyOfFiniteType (𝟙 (Spec (.of k)))
   244	      infer_instance
   245	    rw [← Over.w e.hom]
   246	    infer_instance
   247	  · unfold divRepAffGenusScheme divFunctorAffGenusRepresenter divRepAffScheme_at
   248	      divFunctorAffRepresenter_at
   249	    dsimp only
   250	    rw [dif_neg hg]
   251	    infer_instance
   252	
   253	/-- The certified rank-one divisor open is locally of finite type over the base field. -/
   254	theorem locallyOfFiniteType_divRankOneOpenOver
   255	    (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) (divRepAffP1Map C)) :
   256	    LocallyOfFiniteType (divRankOneOpenOver (divRepAffP1Map C) h).hom := by
   257	  change LocallyOfFiniteType
   258	    (divRankOneOpenMap (divRepAffP1Map C) h ≫ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom)
   259	  letI : IsOpenImmersion (divRankOneOpenMap (divRepAffP1Map C) h) :=
   260	    divRankOneOpen_isOpenImmersion (divRepAffP1Map C) h
   261	  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom :=
   262	    locallyOfFiniteType_divRepAffGenusScheme (C := C)
   263	  infer_instance
   264	
   265	/-- The structure map read from a translated rank-one chart is the structure map of its
   266	rank-one divisor-open source. -/
   267	lemma chartHom_picRankOneTranslatedChart
   268	    (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) (divRepAffP1Map C))
   269	    (a : PicRankOneTranslatorIndex (C := C)) :
   270	    chartHom C (fun a : PicRankOneTranslatorIndex (C := C) =>
   271	      picRankOneTranslatedChart (C := C) h a) a =
   272	      (divRankOneOpenOver (divRepAffP1Map C) h).hom :=
   273	  rfl
   274	
   275	/-! ## From residue-field coverage to pointwise coverage -/
   276	
   277	/-- A family of representable open immersions covers pointwise as soon as it covers the class at
   278	every residue-field point.  Relative representability pulls a chosen field factorization back to
   279	an open immersion over the test; its open range is the required neighborhood. -/
   280	theorem pointwiseCoverage_of_residueField
   281	    {I : Type u} {X : I → Scheme.{u}}
   282	    (f : ∀ i, yoneda.obj (X i) ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1)
   283	    (hf : ∀ i, IsOpenImmersion.presheaf (f i))
   284	    (hfield : ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (s : (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1.obj (op T)) (t : T),
   285	      ∃ (Y : Scheme.{u}) (q : Y) (y : Y ⟶ T) (i : I) (x : Y ⟶ X i),
   286	        y.base q = t ∧
   287	          (f i).app (op Y) x = (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1.map y.op s) :
   288	    PointwiseCoverage C f := by
   289	  intro T s t
   290	  obtain ⟨Y, q, y, i, x, hyt, hx⟩ := hfield T s t
   291	  let g : yoneda.obj T ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1 := yonedaEquiv.symm s
   292	  obtain ⟨Z, snd, fst, hpb⟩ := (hf i).rep g
   293	  letI : IsOpenImmersion snd := (hf i).property g fst snd hpb
   294	  have hpbY := (IsPullback.iff_app.mp hpb) (op Y)
   295	  rw [Types.isPullback_iff] at hpbY
   296	  have hg : g.app (op Y) y = (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1.map y.op s := by
   297	    exact yonedaEquiv_symm_app_apply s _ y
   298	  obtain ⟨z, hz₁, hz₂⟩ := hpbY.2.2 x y (hx.trans hg.symm)
   299	  let W : T.Opens := snd.opensRange
   300	  have htW : t ∈ W := by
   301	    change t ∈ snd.opensRange
   302	    apply Scheme.Hom.mem_opensRange.mpr
   303	    refine ⟨z.base q, ?_⟩
   304	    have hz := congrArg (fun m : Y ⟶ T => m.base q) hz₂
   305	    exact hz.trans hyt
   306	  refine ⟨W, htW, i, fst.app (op (W : Scheme.{u})) snd.isoOpensRange.inv, ?_⟩
   307	  have hpbW := (IsPullback.iff_app.mp hpb) (op (W : Scheme.{u}))
   308	  rw [Types.isPullback_iff] at hpbW
   309	  have hcomm := congrArg
   310	    (fun q => (ConcreteCategory.hom q) snd.isoOpensRange.inv) hpbW.1
   311	  change (f i).app (op (W : Scheme.{u}))
   312	      (fst.app (op (W : Scheme.{u})) snd.isoOpensRange.inv) = _
   313	  change (f i).app (op (W : Scheme.{u}))
   314	      (fst.app (op (W : Scheme.{u})) snd.isoOpensRange.inv) =
   315	    g.app (op (W : Scheme.{u})) (snd.isoOpensRange.inv ≫ snd) at hcomm
   316	  rw [Scheme.Hom.isoOpensRange_inv_comp] at hcomm
   317	  change (f i).app (op (W : Scheme.{u}))
   318	      (fst.app (op (W : Scheme.{u})) snd.isoOpensRange.inv) =
   319	    (yonedaEquiv.symm s).app (op (W : Scheme.{u})) W.ι at hcomm
   320	  rwa [yonedaEquiv_symm_app_apply] at hcomm
   321	
   322	/-! ## The separably closed field-point producer -/
   323	
   324	variable [IsSepClosed k]
   325	
   326	/-- Every degree-zero field class is hit by the translated chart indexed by the exact base class
   327	returned by `exists_sepClosedTranslated_mem_picRankOneOpen`. -/
   328	theorem exists_picRankOneTranslatedChart_fieldFactorization
   329	    (hopen : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen (divRepAffP1Map C))
   330	    {K : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K]
   331	    (mu : pic0Subgroup C (overSpec k K)) :
   332	    ∃ (a : PicRankOneTranslatorIndex (C := C))
   333	      (x : (overSpec k K).left ⟶
   334	        (divRankOneOpenOver (divRepAffP1Map C)
   335	          (divRankOneOpenDataOfPicRankOneOpen (divRepAffP1Map C) hopen)).left),
   336	      (picRankOneTranslatedChart (C := C)
   337	          (divRankOneOpenDataOfPicRankOneOpen (divRepAffP1Map C) hopen) a).app
   338	        (op (overSpec k K).left) x =
   339	          (⟨(overSpec k K).hom, mu⟩ :
   340	            (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1.obj (op (overSpec k K).left)) := by
   341	  obtain ⟨L, hLfield, hkL, hKL, htow, hfin, hsep, d, r, hdeg, hsupp, hmem⟩ :=
   342	    exists_sepClosedTranslated_mem_picRankOneOpen
   343	      (C := C) (divRepAffP1Map C) (divRepAffP1Map_comp C) mu
   344	  letI := hLfield
   345	  letI := hkL
   346	  letI := hKL
   347	  letI := htow
   348	  letI := hfin
   349	  letI := hsep
   350	  let a : PicRankOneTranslatorIndex (C := C) :=
   351	    ⟨chartTwistClass C d.m r.Z, hdeg⟩
   352	  let baseValue : (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1.obj (op (overSpec k K).left) :=
   353	    ⟨(overSpec k K).hom, mu⟩
   354	  let translatedValue :=
   355	    (sigmaExtensionIso (pic0GenusTranslationIso (C := C) a)).hom.app
   356	      (op (overSpec k K).left) baseValue
   357	  have htranslated : translatedValue.2 = r.rankOneLayer mu.1 d := by
   358	    apply Subtype.ext
   359	    change mu.1 * thetaFamily C (chartTwistClass C d.m r.Z) (overSpec k K) = _
   360	    rw [SepClosedTranslatedDropResult.rankOneLayer_coe]
   361	  have htranslatedMem : translatedValue.2 ∈
   362	      (PicRankOneOpen (divRepAffP1Map C)).obj (op (overSpec k K)) := by
   363	    rw [htranslated]
   364	    exact hmem
   365	  let v : (rankOneLocus (C := C) (pi := divRepAffP1Map C)).obj
   366	      (op (overSpec k K).left) :=
   367	    ⟨translatedValue.1, ⟨translatedValue.2, htranslatedMem⟩⟩
   368	  let e := picRankOneOpenSigmaIso (C := C)
   369	    (divRankOneOpenDataOfPicRankOneOpen (divRepAffP1Map C) hopen)
   370	  refine ⟨a, e.inv.app (op (overSpec k K).left) v, ?_⟩
   371	  change (sigmaExtensionIso (pic0GenusTranslationIso (C := C) a)).inv.app _
   372	      ((picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl (divRepAffP1Map C)).app _
   373	        (e.hom.app _ (e.inv.app _ v))) = baseValue
   374	  rw [e.inv_hom_id_app_apply]
   375	  change (sigmaExtensionIso (pic0GenusTranslationIso (C := C) a)).inv.app _
   376	      translatedValue = baseValue
   377	  exact (sigmaExtensionIso (pic0GenusTranslationIso (C := C) a)).hom_inv_id_app_apply
   378	    _ baseValue
   379	
   380	/-! ## Pointwise coverage and representability -/
   381	
   382	set_option maxHeartbeats 800000 in
   383	-- Elaborating the residue-field specialization crosses both sigma-extension dependent fibres.
   384	/-- The translated rank-one charts cover the sigma extension pointwise.  At a point `t`,
   385	restrict the degree-zero class to `Spec κ(t)`, use the exact separably-closed translated
   386	rank-one factorization there, and take the whole residue-field point as the covering source. -/
   387	theorem picRankOneTranslatedChart_pointwiseCoverage
   388	    (hopen : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen (divRepAffP1Map C)) :
   389	    PointwiseCoverage C (fun a : PicRankOneTranslatorIndex (C := C) =>
   390	      picRankOneTranslatedChart (C := C)
   391	        (divRankOneOpenDataOfPicRankOneOpen (divRepAffP1Map C) hopen) a) := by
   392	  apply pointwiseCoverage_of_residueField (C := C)
   393	  · exact fun a => picRankOneTranslatedChart_isOpenImmersion (C := C) hopen a
   394	  · intro T s t
   395	    rcases s with ⟨b, mu⟩
   396	    let Tbar : Over (Spec (.of k)) := Over.mk b
   397	    let K := Over.testPointField (T := Tbar) t
   398	    let p : overSpec k K ⟶ Tbar := Over.testPoint (T := Tbar) t
   399	    let muK : pic0Subgroup C (overSpec k K) := (pic0TypeFunctor C).map p.op mu
   400	    obtain ⟨a, x, hx⟩ :=
   401	      exists_picRankOneTranslatedChart_fieldFactorization (C := C) hopen muK
   402	    let q : (overSpec k K).left := Classical.choice inferInstance
   403	    have hq : p.left.base q = t := by
   404	      dsimp only [p]
   405	      exact Over.testPoint_base (T := Tbar) t q
   406	    refine ⟨(overSpec k K).left, q, p.left, a, x, ?_, ?_⟩
   407	    · exact hq
   408	    · exact hx.trans (Over.sigmaExtension_map_left_mk p mu).symm
   409	
   410	/-- Over a separably closed field, openness of the rank-one Picard locus gives a scheme
   411	representing `Pic^0`.  This conditional form keeps the geometric gluing argument reusable. -/
   412	noncomputable def pic0_sepClosed_representableBy_of_isOpen
   413	    (hopen : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen (divRepAffP1Map C)) :
   414	    Σ J : Over (Spec (.of k)), (pic0TypeFunctor C).RepresentableBy J := by
   415	  let h := divRankOneOpenDataOfPicRankOneOpen (divRepAffP1Map C) hopen
   416	  let f := fun a : PicRankOneTranslatorIndex (C := C) =>
   417	    picRankOneTranslatedChart (C := C) h a
   418	  letI : Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective Scheme.zariskiTopology (Sigma.desc f) :=
   419	    isLocallySurjective_sigmaDesc_of_pointwise C f
   420	      (picRankOneTranslatedChart_pointwiseCoverage (C := C) hopen)
   421	  exact ⟨_, pic0RepresentableByOfCharts C f
   422	    (fun a => picRankOneTranslatedChart_isOpenImmersion (C := C) hopen a)⟩
   423	
   424	/-- Over a separably closed field, `Pic^0` is represented by the scheme obtained by gluing the
   425	translated canonical rank-one Abel charts. -/
   426	noncomputable def pic0_sepClosed_representableBy :
   427	    Σ J : Over (Spec (.of k)), (pic0TypeFunctor C).RepresentableBy J :=
   428	  pic0_sepClosed_representableBy_of_isOpen
   429	    (C := C) (picRankOneOpen_isOpen (divRepAffP1Map C) (divRepAffP1Map_comp C))
   430	
   431	/-- The exact separably closed representing scheme constructed above is locally of finite type
   432	over the base field. -/
   433	theorem locallyOfFiniteType_pic0_sepClosed_representableBy :
   434	    LocallyOfFiniteType (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).1.hom := by
   435	  let hopen := picRankOneOpen_isOpen (C := C)
   436	    (divRepAffP1Map C) (divRepAffP1Map_comp C)
   437	  let h := divRankOneOpenDataOfPicRankOneOpen (divRepAffP1Map C) hopen
   438	  let f := fun a : PicRankOneTranslatorIndex (C := C) =>
   439	    picRankOneTranslatedChart (C := C) h a
   440	  let hf := fun a : PicRankOneTranslatorIndex (C := C) =>
   441	    picRankOneTranslatedChart_isOpenImmersion (C := C) hopen a
   442	  letI : Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective Scheme.zariskiTopology (Sigma.desc f) :=
   443	    isLocallySurjective_sigmaDesc_of_pointwise C f
   444	      (picRankOneTranslatedChart_pointwiseCoverage (C := C) hopen)
   445	  change LocallyOfFiniteType (gluedHom C f hf)
   446	  apply locallyOfFiniteType_gluedHom C f hf
   447	  intro a
   448	  rw [chartHom_picRankOneTranslatedChart]
   449	  exact locallyOfFiniteType_divRankOneOpenOver h
   450	
   451	end
   452	
   453	end AlgebraicGeometry

/-

Authors: The AlgebraicJacobian Contributors

import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivRepAffChallenge
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivSchemeQProj

/-!
# The concrete project-local model of the admissible divisor representer

The admissible coverage parameter is strictly positive, so the chosen representer in
`DivRepAffChallenge` is definitionally the nonzero `DivScheme` branch.  This file names that
concrete branch and transports its closed immersion into the Grassmannian pair back to
`divRepAffAdmissibleScheme`.

The resulting certificate is unconditional and geometric: the target has its finite affine
product atlas, and the source is quasi-compact, locally of finite type, and separated over the
base field.  It is not yet a finite-projective-space immersion.  That stronger conclusion needs
the Plucker embeddings of both Grassmannian factors together with their Segre product; those
maps are not present in the rebuild project.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option quotPrecheck false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 8
set_option maxRecDepth 16000

universe u

open CategoryTheory

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

open Grassmannian Scheme

attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
  Scheme.functionFieldOverModule
attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver

section Curve

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]

noncomputable local instance admissibleDivisorOver :
    C.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := .ofHom C.hom

local instance admissibleDivisorSmooth :
    SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
  inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom)

local instance admissibleDivisorIntegral : IsIntegral C.left :=
  isIntegral_left_of_geometricallyReduced C

local instance admissibleDivisorLocallyOfFiniteType :
    LocallyOfFiniteType (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
  inferInstanceAs (LocallyOfFiniteType C.hom)

local instance admissibleDivisorQuasiCompact :
    QuasiCompact (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
  inferInstanceAs (QuasiCompact C.hom)

noncomputable local instance admissibleDivisorHModuleFiniteZero :
    Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 0) :=
  moduleFinite_hModule_zero C

noncomputable local instance admissibleDivisorHModuleFiniteOne :
    Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 1) :=
  moduleFinite_hModule_one C

/-- The chosen finite map is over `Spec k`, in the spelling used by the divisor-window API. -/
theorem divRepAffP1Map_comp_over :
    divRepAffP1Map C ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.left ↘ Spec (.of k) := by
  change divRepAffP1Map C ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom
  exact divRepAffP1Map_comp C

/-- The admissible parameter never enters the degree-zero terminal branch of the generic
representer.  Positivity follows from the positive window bound and the positive theta degree. -/
theorem divRepAffAdmissibleParameter_pos :
    0 < divRepAffAdmissibleParameter C := by
  letI : C.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := .ofHom C.hom
  haveI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom)
  haveI : IsIntegral C.left := isIntegral_left_of_geometricallyReduced C
  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (LocallyOfFiniteType C.hom)
  haveI : QuasiCompact (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (QuasiCompact C.hom)
  haveI : Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 0) :=
    moduleFinite_hModule_zero C
  haveI : Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 1) :=
    moduleFinite_hModule_one C
  have hpi : divRepAffP1Map C ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.left ↘ Spec (.of k) :=
    divRepAffP1Map_comp C
  have hb := windowBound_pos (divRepAffP1Map C) hpi
  have hM := windowBound_le_M_mul
    (divRepAffP1Map C) hpi (genus C)
  have hd := one_le_classDeg_thetaCechClass (C := C)
  have hcast := admissibleCoverageParameter_cast
    (C := C) hpi (genus C)
  change 0 < admissibleCoverageParameter
    (C := C) hpi (genus C)
  have hpos : (0 : ℤ) <
      ((windowM_choice (divRepAffP1Map C) hpi (genus C) : ℤ) *
        windowδ (divRepAffP1Map C) + (genus C : ℤ)) *
        classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) := by
    nlinarith [Int.natCast_nonneg (genus C)]
  exact_mod_cast hcast.symm ▸ hpos

/-- Rank of the first Grassmannian window in the concrete admissible divisor model. -/
noncomputable def divRepAffAdmissibleWindowRankOne : ℕ :=
  Module.finrank k
    ↥(divisorSections k
      (windowM_choice (divRepAffP1Map C) (divRepAffP1Map_comp_over C)
        (divRepAffAdmissibleParameter C) • fiberWeilDivisor (divRepAffP1Map C)) ⊤)

/-- Rank of the second Grassmannian window in the concrete admissible divisor model. -/
noncomputable def divRepAffAdmissibleWindowRankTwo : ℕ :=
  Module.finrank k
    ↥(divisorSections k
      ((windowM_choice (divRepAffP1Map C) (divRepAffP1Map_comp_over C)
          (divRepAffAdmissibleParameter C) +
        windowS_choice (divRepAffP1Map C) (divRepAffP1Map_comp_over C)
          (divRepAffAdmissibleParameter C)) •
        fiberWeilDivisor (divRepAffP1Map C)) ⊤)

/-- The internally chosen finite basis of the first admissible window. -/
noncomputable def divRepAffAdmissibleWindowBasisOne :
    Module.Basis (Fin (divRepAffAdmissibleWindowRankOne C)) k
      ↥(divisorSections k
        (windowM_choice (divRepAffP1Map C) (divRepAffP1Map_comp_over C)
          (divRepAffAdmissibleParameter C) • fiberWeilDivisor (divRepAffP1Map C)) ⊤) :=
  Module.finBasis k _

/-- The internally chosen finite basis of the second admissible window. -/
noncomputable def divRepAffAdmissibleWindowBasisTwo :
    Module.Basis (Fin (divRepAffAdmissibleWindowRankTwo C)) k
      ↥(divisorSections k
        ((windowM_choice (divRepAffP1Map C) (divRepAffP1Map_comp_over C)
            (divRepAffAdmissibleParameter C) +
          windowS_choice (divRepAffP1Map C) (divRepAffP1Map_comp_over C)
            (divRepAffAdmissibleParameter C)) •
          fiberWeilDivisor (divRepAffP1Map C)) ⊤) :=

import AlgebraicJacobian.Descent.SemilinearAction
import Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Morphisms.Affine

/-!
# Finite subsets in affine opens

`Scheme.FiniteInAffine X` is the action-free geometric condition behind the
finite-Galois quotient construction: every finite subset of `X` lies in one
affine open.  For a finite Galois extension, this immediately supplies
`SemilinearGalAction.OrbitsInAffineOpen` for every action on `X`.

The property is stated independently of Picard data.  In particular, it is a
conclusion to be proved for a representing scheme, not an additional field of
the representability datum.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory
open AlgebraicJacobian.GaloisDescent

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme

/-- Every finite subset of a scheme is contained in a single affine open. -/
def FiniteInAffine (X : Scheme.{u}) : Prop :=
  ∀ s : Set X, s.Finite → ∃ U : X.affineOpens, s ⊆ U.1

/-- An affine scheme satisfies `FiniteInAffine`. -/
theorem finiteInAffine_of_isAffine (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine X] :
    FiniteInAffine X :=
  fun _ _ ↦ ⟨⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top X⟩, fun _ _ ↦ trivial⟩

/-- `FiniteInAffine` is invariant under isomorphism. -/
theorem finiteInAffine_of_iso {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (e : X ≅ Y)
    (h : FiniteInAffine X) : FiniteInAffine Y := by
  intro s hs
  obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ := h (e.hom.base ⁻¹' s)
    (hs.preimage (TopCat.homeoOfIso ((Scheme.forgetToTop).mapIso e)).injective.injOn)
  refine ⟨⟨e.hom ''ᵁ U.1, U.2.image_of_isOpenImmersion e.hom⟩, ?_⟩
  intro y hy
  exact ⟨e.inv.base y, hU (by simpa using hy), by simp⟩

/-- `FiniteInAffine` descends along an affine morphism. -/
theorem finiteInAffine_of_isAffineHom {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsAffineHom f] (h : FiniteInAffine Y) : FiniteInAffine X := by
  intro s hs
  obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ := h (f.base '' s) (hs.image _)
  exact ⟨⟨f ⁻¹ᵁ U.1, U.2.preimage f⟩, fun x hx ↦ hU ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩⟩

/-- An object affine over a field spectrum satisfies `FiniteInAffine`. -/
theorem finiteInAffine_left_of_isAffineHom {k : Type u} [Field k]
    (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) [IsAffineHom X.hom] :
    FiniteInAffine X.left :=
  haveI := isAffine_of_isAffineHom X.hom
  finiteInAffine_of_isAffine _

/-- `FiniteInAffine` supplies the orbit condition for every finite-Galois
semilinear action on the scheme. -/
theorem orbitsInAffineOpen_of_finiteInAffine
    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
    (rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f) (h : FiniteInAffine X) :
    rho.OrbitsInAffineOpen where
  exists_affineOpen x := by
    obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ :=
      h (Set.range fun gamma : L ≃ₐ[K] L ↦ (rho.act gamma).hom.base x)
        (Set.finite_range _)
    exact ⟨U, fun gamma ↦ hU ⟨gamma, rfl⟩⟩

end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme

    (rho' : SemilinearGalAction K L X' f') (h : X ⟶ X') : Prop :=
  ∀ gamma : L ≃ₐ[K] L,

/-- The orbit of a point under a semilinear action. -/
def orbit (rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f) (x : X) : Set X :=
  Set.range fun gamma : L ≃ₐ[K] L => (rho.act gamma).hom.base x

/-- The geometric condition required for the finite-Galois quotient to remain
a scheme: every orbit lies in one affine open. -/
class OrbitsInAffineOpen (rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f) : Prop where
  exists_affineOpen (x : X) :
    ∃ U : X.affineOpens,
      ∀ gamma : L ≃ₐ[K] L, (rho.act gamma).hom.base x ∈ U.1

/-- A stable open subset of a semilinearly acted scheme. -/
def IsStableOpen (rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f) (U : X.Opens) : Prop :=
  ∀ gamma : L ≃ₐ[K] L, (rho.act gamma).hom ⁻¹ᵁ U = U

end SemilinearGalAction

/-- A stable affine neighbourhood of every point.  The quotient engine derives
this from `OrbitsInAffineOpen` for finite Galois extensions. -/
class HasStableAffineCover {X : Scheme.{u}}
    {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
    (rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f) : Prop where
  exists_stable_affineOpen (x : X) :
    ∃ U : X.Opens, IsAffineOpen U ∧ x ∈ U ∧ rho.IsStableOpen U
